court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: Additional Sessions Court / Fast Track Court-I, Erode - C.A.No.252 of 2007
facts_of_case: The respondent filed a case against the petitioner and 8 others for alleged offence under Section 494 r/w 109 I.P.C. The petitioner was convicted and sentenced. He then appealed to this court.

legal_principles.principle: At the appellate stage, a party cannot adduce additional evidence as a matter of fact.
legal_principles.held: The learned judge observed that at that time, the petitioner had not raised any questions with regard to the evidence let in by P.W.1 in C.C.No.426 of 2004.

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot say that only now they have come to know about the evidence let in by a witness, if the evidence was recorded in their presence.
legal_principles.held: The learned judge observed that P.W.1 was examined in chief in C.C.No.426 of 2004, on 21.07.2005 itself.

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot recall a witness for cross-examination after the main case has been decided on merits.
legal_principles.held: The learned judge observed that at this stage, the petition was filed before the trial Court for additional evidence in order to drag on the proceedings.

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot delay the proceedings by filing multiple petitions.
legal_principles.held: The learned counsel for the respondent argued that the revision petitioner had filed one more Criminal Revision before this Court for transfer of the appeal. That was however dismissed.

outcome.final_order: The trial court's order is set aside.
